overallReasoning.summary: The deployed private foundation provides a Premium registry, ZRS Blob account, user-assigned managed identity, internal Consumption Container Apps environment, VNet subnets and private endpoints. The prepared manual job is not provisioned. Its identity has scoped input-read, output-contribute and registry-pull roles. AMPLS provides the private Monitor configuration; environment diagnostics use azure-monitor without shared keys. Live workload behavior remains unverified.
overallReasoning.tradeoffs: Nonproduction batch foundation; no production availability claim. The user approved approximately $98/month of core standing cost plus usage and the still-unpriced private builder/access path on 2026-10-15. No Key Vault because runtime needs no secrets; no Application Insights because this CLI uses structured status logs. No Firewall/NAT/egress filtering, global recovery, automatic quarantine, signed-image enforcement or customer-managed keys. Platform outbound traffic remains possible. Read-only tenant inventory identified only a retained Network Watcher before this deployment; no existing resource is intentionally changed. Four recorded insights are applied.

wafSummary.compute: Consumption manual batch matches the existing CLI. Private networking, identity and diagnostics are implemented. Multi-zone/multi-region availability, always-on replicas and ingress probes are unnecessary for this nonproduction batch experiment and are not claimed.
wafSummary.storage: Private endpoints, Entra authorization, secure transfer, versioning, recovery and lifecycle controls protect the inputs and outputs. Zone-redundant storage improves in-region resilience; geo-recovery remains undecided.
wafSummary.registry: Premium enables private endpoints. Disable local admin, anonymous pulls, public ingress and network bypass; require a VNet-connected publisher. Pin the image digest, with scanning and release enforcement treated as separate work.
wafSummary.monitoring: Use Azure Monitor diagnostic settings without workspace shared keys. Private queries use AMPLS and its five DNS zones; workspace local authorization and public query/ingestion are disabled. A single isolated DNS domain is assumed.
